recPick.title: Pocket‑size USB‑C controller for real gaming on your phone, not just thumbs swiping
recPick.body: Imagine snapping a deck‑of‑cards‑sized controller onto your phone and actually playing like there's no touchscreen lag. The Razer Prio folds flat in your pocket, plugs into your USB‑C, and snaps open into proper joysticks and buttons—perfect for your commute, casual sessions, or quick rounds. Worth it now because it just launched in September and solves the ‘janky touchscreen’ trap, but it adds bulk when folded out and you’re limited to cables, not Bluetooth.
